title: Bessel Function Analysis of Nesterov's ODE in $N$-Player Quadratic Games
summary: We analyze Nesterov's accelerated gradient descent (NAGD) for Nash equilibrium seeking in $N$-player quadratic games. While the continuous-time NAGD dynamics - the Su-Boyd-Candès ODE - are well understood for convex optimization, their behavior with non-symmetric pseudo-gradient matrices arising in games has not been characterized precisely.
